column1: # Pinned Terra repository signing keys, one per Fedora release.
# Terra publishes a per-release key at
# that key over HTTPS and refuses to import it unless the fingerprint matches
# the value pinned here, so a later compromise of the distribution host cannot
# silently substitute a different signing key.
